watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Not every great gift is glamorous. A gentle electric #toothbrush says “I want you to feel good every single day.” Perfect for the woman 40+ who takes care of everyone else first. #giftsforher #holidayseason #gifts

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Menopause can change how your mouth feels, from sensitive gums to dryness. A soft-bristle electric brush with a pressure sensor is a quiet, practical gift she will use daily. #gifts #giftideas #giftsforher

drafts_today.text: Women 40+: what moisturizer do you refuse to run out of this winter? Mine is my RIMAN night cream — rich enough for menopause-dry skin without the greasy film. Drop yours below so we can all steal good ideas. #DrySkin #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: hold up the RIMAN jar, on-screen text "The one I refuse to run out of", then point to comments.

drafts_today.text: If your face still feels tight after moisturizer, you are not under-creaming. Your barrier wants gentler cleansing and cream on damp skin. My three-step: soft cleanse, hydrate while wet, seal with RIMAN at night. #SkinBarrier #WinterSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: mist/dampen face, apply cream while skin is shiny-wet, caption "Damp skin first".

drafts_today.text: Holiday gift for the woman 40+ who buys everyone else's presents first: skip the novelty set. One richer night cream she will actually finish. Barrier care is love. I keep RIMAN on my list. #GiftsForHer #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: wrap a single night cream, unwrap to the jar label, end on "One product she'll finish".
